name: Dongjiang Environmental Company Limited
summary: Dongjiang Environmental Company Limited, along with its subsidiary entities, is a prominent enterprise engaged in the environmental protection sector throughout the People's Republic of China. The company's operations are diversified across seven distinct segments: Industrial Waste Recycling, Industrial Waste Treatment and Disposal, Municipal Waste Treatment and Disposal, Renewable Energy Utilization, Environmental Engineering and Services, Trading and Others, and Household Appliance Dismantling. Its core offerings encompass the processing and sale of recycled goods, comprehensive waste treatment provisions, the construction and maintenance of environmental protection systems, and the trade of chemical products. Established in 1999 and headquartered in Shenzhen, PRC, the organization was previously known as Shenzhen Dongjiang Environmental Company Limited, adopting its current name in December 2010.
